paragraphs: Millrose Properties, Inc. is a corporation incorporated under the laws of the State of Maryland on March 19, 2024 and later spun-off by Lennar. The Spin-Off was completed on February 7, 2025, at which time we became an independent, publicly traded company and our Class A common stock was listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "MRP".

Millrose purchases and develops residential land and sells finished homesites to homebuilders by way of option contracts with predetermined costs and takedown schedules. We serve as a solution for homebuilders seeking to expand access to finished homesites while implementing an asset-light strategy. Our option contracts provide for the payment of recurring cash option fees as compensation for the capital and operational solution delivered by the Millrose platform. As Millrose sells fully developed homesites, capital is recycled into future land acquisitions for homebuilders, providing counterparties with durable access to community growth. To a lesser extent, we also provide development loans secured by property intended for residential use.
We are externally managed and advised by our Manager, Kennedy Lewis Land and Residential Advisors LLC, pursuant to the Management Agreement between Millrose and KL entered into on February 7, 2025.

Core to our value offering is our technology platform, a proprietary land banking data warehouse and enterprise resource planning (ERP) system developed and deployed by our Manager. Our technology uniquely empowers us to perform fast, accurate due diligence, process a high volume of transactions, and manage assets across diverse geographies.

We have one reportable segment that derives revenue primarily from our portfolio of homesites under option contracts. To a lesser extent, we earn interest income on the outstanding loan balance of development loans secured by residential property. Our operations are conducted in the United States. As of December 31, 2025, we had 142,139 homesites in 933 properties (also known as communities) across 30 states.

We intend to elect to be treated as a REIT for U.S. federal income tax purposes beginning with our taxable year ended December 31, 2025. Millrose Properties, Inc. is a holding company whose operations are conducted primarily through MPH Parent, a Delaware limited liability company and a wholly owned operating subsidiary of Millrose, and other subsidiaries, including Millrose Holdings, a Delaware limited liability company and a wholly owned operating subsidiary of MPH Parent. Millrose and MPH Parent made a joint election to treat MPH Parent as a TRS of Millrose. Accordingly, MPH Parent will be subject to full entity-level taxation in connection with its business operations. Similarly, we expect that our other TRSs will be taxable business entities.

On February 7, 2025, we completed our Spin-Off from Lennar through a distribution of approximately 80% of our Common Stock to holders of Lennar common stock as of the close of business on January 21, 2025. In connection with the Spin-Off, we received a contribution from Lennar of approximately $5.5 billion in land assets, representing approximately 87,000 homesites, and cash of approximately $1.0 billion, which included $585 million of cash deposit liabilities related to option contracts with Lennar. In addition, Millrose entered into the Revolving Credit Agreement with a commitment amount of up to $1.335 billion (together with the Revolving Credit Agreement, the "Revolving Credit Facility") that is scheduled to mature on February 7, 2028.

On February 10, 2025, we acquired approximately 25,000 homesites through the acquisition of 100% of the outstanding stock of RCH Holdings, Inc., a newly formed parent holding company of Rausch, for approximately $859 million in cash, which is net of option deposits funded by Lennar and other holdbacks.

On May 12, 2025, we entered into a commitment with the New Home Company ("New Home") for Millrose to provide land banking capital of up to $700 million to support New Home's acquisition of Landsea Homes ("Landsea"). On June 25, 2025, New Home completed the acquisition of Landsea and we funded land banking capital of $494.5 million at closing, acquiring a portfolio of homesites, subject to option agreements with New Home. As a result of the transaction, we acquired $522.8 million in land assets, consisting of 4,186 homesites, for $494.5 million in cash, which is net of deposits of $28.3 million related to the option contracts.

In connection with the New Home transaction, on June 24, 2025, Millrose entered into the DDTL Credit Agreement that provided for a delayed draw term loan facility (the "DDTL Credit Facility") with commitments in the aggregate amount of $1.0 billion that was scheduled to mature on June 23, 2026. Proceeds of the DDTL Credit Facility were used to fund the New Home acquisition of Landsea and any remaining proceeds were available for general corporate purposes. On September 11, 2025, the DDTL Credit Agreement was terminated and all obligations thereunder were repaid in full.
During the third quarter of 2025, we strengthened our capital structure through two senior notes offerings:

• On August 7, 2025, we issued $1.25 billion aggregate principal amount of 6.375% senior notes due 2030, using the net proceeds therefrom to repay $500 million principal amount outstanding under the DDTL Credit Facility and $450 million principal amount outstanding under the Revolving Credit Facility, and the remainder was used for general corporate purposes.

• On September 11, 2025, we issued $750 million aggregate principal amount of 6.25% senior notes due 2032, using the net proceeds therefrom to repay the entire $500 million remaining principal amount outstanding under the DDTL Credit Facility, and related expenses. The remainder was used for general corporate purposes.

On October 10, 2025, Lennar exercised its registration rights pursuant to the Registration Rights Agreement and commenced an offer to exchange the approximately 20% of the total outstanding shares of Class A Common Stock of Millrose that it owned as of September 30, 2025 for outstanding shares of Lennar Class A common stock (the "Exchange Offer"). On November 26, 2025, Lennar announced the results of the Exchange Offer through which Lennar accepted an aggregate of 8,049,594 shares of Lennar Class A common stock in exchange for 33,298,754 shares of Class A Common Stock of Millrose. The Exchange Offer was completed on November 28, 2025. As a result, Lennar now owns a de minimis amount of Common Stock following the completion of the Exchange Offer.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business Model and Investment in a Recently Formed Entity

We are a recently formed company with limited operating history, and you have a limited basis on which to evaluate our ability to achieve our business objectives or to perform as a standalone and separate business.

The Rausch Transaction included properties outside of the geographies in which Lennar has historically operated, and property values in those geographies may be different from those in which Lennar has operated.
We are subject to risks associated with having a highly concentrated portfolio.
Our recycled capital business model is contingent on our counterparties electing to exercise their land purchase options.
Our agreements with Lennar involve conflicts of interest, and we might have received better terms from unaffiliated third parties than the terms we received in these agreements.
Any exercise by Lennar of its Enforcement Rights pursuant to the Founder's Rights Agreement may severely negatively impact our business operations and financial condition.
We have not obtained independent appraisals or fairness opinions as to the value of our real estate assets, including those acquired in the Spin-Off from Lennar and in the Rausch Transaction.
We have not obtained environmental reports on all of our real estate assets, and we rely upon our counterparties for certain information regarding the homesites.

Ownership of real estate assets is subject to environmental risks and liabilities, which may not be covered by the representations and warranties and indemnities provided to us in the counterparty agreements.
We are subject to a wide range of general and industry-specific laws and regulations relating to the protection of the environment which require compliance that can be burdensome and expensive.
Our counterparties' obligation to undertake Land Development on our land assets may negatively impact our business.
If we or our major counterparties, including Lennar, enter into bankruptcy, the counterparty agreements may be unenforceable.
If we cannot continue to enter into new counterparty agreements, which may be limited by the Capital Priority Right, our business and sources of income could be materially and adversely affected.
Declines in the market value of our Real Estate Portfolio could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, and result of operations.
Past performance by the management team, who are employees of Kennedy Lewis and their respective affiliates, may not be indicative of our future performance.
If we are not able to raise additional capital to fund our operations, or if we cannot access capital on attractive terms, we may not always have sufficient funding to maintain our operations.
Volatility in the market may impact our ability to do business.
As a holding company, our dependence on our subsidiaries for cash flow may negatively affect our business.
Your investment return may be adversely affected if we are required to register as an investment company under the Investment Company Act.
Disruptions to our technology platform could impair our ability to execute transactions and recycle capital.
Risks Related to Our Debt Obligations
We may not be able to generate sufficient cash to service all of our indebtedness.
Despite our current indebtedness levels, we may still be able to incur substantially more debt, including secured indebtedness, and other obligations.
Our debt agreements contain restrictions that limit our flexibility in operating our business.
Our indebtedness subjects us to interest rate risk.
Risks Related to the Land Banking Industry
There are significant risks inherent in owning land for new home construction.
Our business is susceptible to risks from natural disasters, geopolitical events and other factors outside of our control that may delay development of land assets that we hold for homebuilders.
Our insurance coverage may not be sufficient to cover all potential losses.
paragraphs: Our business involves substantial risks. Any of the risk factors described below or elsewhere in this Form 10-K could significantly and adversely affect our business prospects, financial condition and results of operations. The risks described below are not the only ones facing us. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently deem to be immaterial may also adversely affect us.

Millrose was incorporated as a Maryland corporation on March 19, 2024 and its Class A Common Stock was listed on the NYSE on February 7, 2025 at the time of the Spin-Off from Lennar. Because we have limited operating history as an independent public company, you have a limited basis upon which to evaluate our ability to achieve our business objectives and perform as a standalone and separate business. The financial information included in this Form 10-K for the periods prior to the Spin-Off do not reflect the financial condition, results of operations or cash flows that we probably would have achieved as a separate, publicly-traded company during the pre-Spin-Off periods, or those that we are likely achieve in the future. The financial information of the Predecessor Millrose Business prior to the Spin-Off also does not reflect the additional costs required to operate as a publicly traded company and maintain compliance with all applicable laws and regulations to which publicly traded companies are subject.

If we fail to achieve our business objectives, we will generate limited operating revenues which may not allow us to perform and grow as a standalone business. Factors that could materially and adversely impact our results may include, but are not limited to, the following:

• The Spin-Off did not include the carryover of any existing operations, personnel or other infrastructure. We do not benefit from administrative and support services from Lennar and instead rely on the Manager pursuant to the terms of the Management Agreement. As such, our business, operations, facilities, personnel, infrastructure, systems and other resources are all recently formed and wholly separate from and not comparable to those of Lennar, except with respect to the services provided by Lennar pursuant to the Master Program Agreement.

• We have incurred and will continue to incur increased expenses as a recently formed, independent public company, which have been paid and will be paid for by our Manager as part of the Manager's responsibilities (such expenses are covered by the Management Fee and are not separately reimbursed by us to our Manager), except as described under "Part I, Item 1. Business —Our Manager."

• Since the Spin-Off, our primary business and source of revenues have been and will continue to be from Lennar pursuant to the Lennar Agreements. While Millrose has acquired other homebuilders as new counterparties, there is no guarantee that Millrose will continue to be successful in negotiating agreements with additional counterparties. Millrose expects that future arrangements will be similar to its current arrangements with counterparties, but there is no certainty that Millrose will be able to successfully negotiate for substantially all of the same terms it has in the current counterparty agreements, including with respect to pooling.

As further described in Note 1. Description of Business to our consolidated financial statements included in "Part II, Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data" of this Form 10-K, we completed the Spin-Off from Lennar on February 7, 2025. The financial information presented herein (i) for the periods prior to the February 7, 2025 Spin-Off is that of the Predecessor Millrose Business and is derived from the consolidated financial statements and accounting records of Lennar, and (ii) for the periods after the February 7, 2025 Spin-Off is that of Millrose and its subsidiaries. Millrose was formed on March 19, 2024 and has operated as an independent company since the Spin-Off on February 7, 2025.

Millrose is a corporation incorporated under the laws of the State of Maryland on March 19, 2024. Millrose became an independent, publicly traded company on February 7, 2025 following the Spin-Off from Lennar and its Class A Common Stock is listed on the NYSE under the symbol "MRP". We purchase and develop residential land and sell finished homesites to homebuilders by way of option contracts with predetermined costs and takedown schedules. We serve as a solution for homebuilders seeking to expand access to finished homesites while implementing an asset-light strategy. As fully developed homesites are sold by Millrose, capital is recycled into future land acquisitions for homebuilders, providing counterparties with durable access to community growth. Our option contracts provide for the payment of recurring option fees paid by our counterparties through the term of the applicable contract. To a lesser extent, we also provide development loans secured by property intended for single-family use to certain third-party counterparties. We are externally managed and advised by KL pursuant to the Management Agreement.

On the Distribution Date, we completed our Spin-Off from Lennar through a distribution of approximately 80% of Millrose's outstanding Common Stock to holders of Lennar Common Stock as of the close of business on January 21, 2025. In connection with the Spin-Off, we received a contribution from Lennar of approximately $5.5 billion in land assets, representing approximately 87,000 homesites, and cash of approximately $1.0 billion, which included $585 million of cash deposit liabilities related to option contracts with Lennar.

On February 10, 2025, we completed the acquisition of land consisting of approximately 25,000 homesites through the acquisition of 100% of the outstanding stock of RCH Holdings, Inc., a recently formed parent holding company of Rausch, for approximately $859 million in cash, which is net of option deposits funded by Lennar and other holdbacks.

On October 10, 2025, Lennar exercised its registration rights pursuant to the Registration Rights Agreement and commenced the Exchange Offer. On November 26, 2025, Lennar announced the results of the Exchange Offer through which Lennar accepted an aggregate of 8,049,594 shares of Lennar Class A common stock in exchange for 33,298,754 shares of Class A Common Stock of Millrose. The Exchange Offer was completed on November 28, 2025. As a result, Lennar now owns a de minimis amount of Common Stock following the completion of the Exchange Offer.

On May 12, 2025, the Company entered into a commitment with New Home for Millrose to provide land banking capital of up to $700 million to support New Home's acquisition of Landsea. On June 25, 2025, New Home completed the acquisition of Landsea and the Company funded land banking capital of $494.5 million at closing for the acquisition of a portfolio of homesites on which the Company executed option agreements with New Home. As a result of the transaction, the Company acquired $522.8 million in land assets, consisting of 4,186 homesites for $494.5 million in cash, which is net of deposits of $28.3 million related to the option contracts.

In connection with the New Home transaction, on June 24, 2025, the Company entered into the DDTL Credit Agreement that provided for a delayed draw term loan facility with commitments in the aggregate amount of $1.0 billion that was scheduled to mature on June 23, 2026. Proceeds of the DDTL Credit Agreement were used to fund the New Home acquisition of Landsea and any remaining proceeds were available for general corporate purposes. On September 11, 2025, the DDTL Credit Agreement was terminated and all obligations thereunder were repaid in full (as further described below).

On August 7, 2025, the Company completed the offering of $1.25 billion aggregate principal amount of the 2030 Notes (the "August 2025 Offering"). Net proceeds of the August 2025 Offering were used to repay $500 million principal amount outstanding under the DDTL Credit Facility and $450 million principal amount outstanding under the Revolving Credit Facility, and the remainder was used for general corporate purposes.

On September 11, 2025, the Company completed the offering of $750 million aggregate principal amount of the 2032 Notes (the "September 2025 Offering"). Net proceeds of the September 2025 Offering were used to repay the entire $500 million remaining principal amount outstanding under the DDTL Credit Facility, and related expenses. The remainder was used for general corporate purposes.

Invested Capital is a non-GAAP financial measure that represents the balance on which monthly cash option fees are paid by counterparties. Invested Capital includes certain components of our consolidated financial statements related to (i) homesites under option contracts, (ii) development loans receivable, and (ii) liabilities. The most directly comparable GAAP financial measure is homesites under option contracts as presented in the Company's consolidated balance sheets. Management uses Invested Capital as a measure of the capital deployed and believes that the figure is useful to investors because it serves as the basis for generating option fees and other related income. This non-GAAP measure is presented solely to permit investors to understand how our management assesses underlying performance and is not, and should not be viewed as, a substitute for GAAP measures, and should be viewed in conjunction with our GAAP financial measures.

paragraphs: Millrose Properties, Inc. 為一間依照馬裏蘭州法律於2024年3月19日成立的公司，後由Lennar分拆而出。分拆作業於2025年2月7日完成，此時本公司成為一間獨立且公開上市的公司，並於紐約證券交易所上市交易，股票代碼為"MRP"。

Millrose 購買並開發住宅用地，透過預定成本與提撥計畫的選擇權契約，將完工住宅地出售給住宅建商。我們為尋求擴大完工住宅地存取管道的住宅建商提供解決方案，同時實行輕資產策略。我們的選擇權契約規定，建商需支付定期現金選擇權費用，作為對Millrose平台所提供的資本與運營解決方案之報酬。當Millrose出售完工住宅地時，資金可重新運用於未來的住宅用地取得，為交易對手提供長期的社區成長存取管道。在較小程度上，我們也提供以住宅用途不動產為擔保的開發貸款。
本公司由我們的經理Kennedy Lewis Land and Residential Advisors LLC 外部管理與建議，根據Millrose與KL於2025年2月7日簽訂的管理契約。
我們價值提案的核心為我們的科技平台，為一項由我們經理開發與部署的專屬土地銀行資料倉儲與企業資源規劃（ERP）系統。我們的科技獨特地賦予我們執行快速且準確的盡職調查、處理大量交易，並管理跨多個地理區域資產的能力。
我們有一個應報告分部，其營業收入主要來自我們在選擇權契約下的完工住宅地組合。在較小程度上，我們也從以住宅用途不動產為擔保的開發貸款未償還貸款餘額中獲取利息收入。我們的業務運作於美國進行。截至2025年12月31日，我們在30個州擁有142,139個完工住宅地，分佈在933個物業（亦稱為社區）。

我們預計自2025年結算年度起，選擇以美國聯邦所得稅目的被視為REIT。Millrose Properties, Inc. 為一間控股公司，其業務主要透過 MPH Parent，一間設立於特拉華州的有限責任公司，且為Millrose的 wholly owned operating subsidiary，及其他子公司進行，包括Millrose Holdings，一間設立於特拉華州的有限責任公司，且為 MPH Parent 的 wholly owned operating subsidiary。Millrose 與 MPH Parent 共同作出選擇，將 MPH Parent 視為 Millrose 的 TRS。因此，MPH Parent 將就其業務運作面臨完整的實體層稅收。同樣地，我們預期我們的其他 TRS 也會被視為課稅商業實體。

於 2025 年 2 月 7 日，我們透過將約 80% 的普通股發放給 2025 年 1 月 21 日營業日結束時持有 Lennar 普通股的股東，完成了與 Lennar 的分拆。配合此次分拆，我們從 Lennar 收到約 5.5 十億美元的土地資產，代表約 87,000 個住宅用地，以及約 1.0 十億美元現金，其中包括與 Lennar 的選擇權契約相關的 585 百萬美元現金存款負債。此外，Millrose 與銀行簽訂了循環信貸協議，信貸額度最高為 1.335 十億美元（與循環信貸協議合稱為「循環信貸設施」），預計於 2028 年 2 月 7 日到期。
2025年2月10日，我們透過收購RCH Holdings, Inc. 100%的已發行股票，取得約25,000個完工住宅地，RCH Holdings, Inc. 為Rausch的新成立母公司，交易總金額約為8.59億美元現金，扣除由Lennar資助的選擇權押金及其他保留款項後的淨額。

於 2025 年 5 月 12 日，本公司與 New Home Company（"New Home"）簽訂協議，由 Millrose 向 New Home 提供最高達 7 億美元的土地銀行資金，以支持 New Home 收購 Landsea Homes（"Landsea"）。於 2025 年 6 月 25 日，New Home 完成對 Landsea 的收購，本公司在交割時提供 4.945 億美元的土地銀行資金，取得一組住宅用地，並與 New Home 簽訂選擇權協議。因該交易，本公司取得價值 5.228 億美元的土地資產，包含 4,186 個住宅用地，以 4.945 億美元現金取得，扣除與選擇權契約相關的 2,830 萬美元存款。

配合 New Home 交易，於 2025 年 6 月 24 日，Millrose 與 DDTL 簽訂信用協議，提供延後提款的長期貸款設施（"DDTL 信用設施"），總承諾金額為 10 億美元，原定於 2026 年 6 月 23 日到期。DDTL 信用設施的資金用於資助 New Home 收購 Landsea，以及任何剩餘資金可用於一般企業用途。於 2025 年 9 月 11 日，DDTL 信用協議終止，並償還所有相關義務。
於 2025 年第三季，本公司透過兩筆高級債券發行強化資本結構：
• 於 2025 年 8 月 7 日，我們發行了總金額為 1.25 十億美元的 6.375% 高收益票據，到期日為 2030 年，使用所得淨資金償還 DDTL 信貸設施下約 5 億美元本金以及循環信貸設施下約 4.5 億美元本金，餘款則用於一般營運用途。
• 於 2025 年 9 月 11 日，本公司發行總本金金額為 7.5 億美元的 6.25% 高級債券，到期日為 2032 年，使用所得資金償還 DDTL 信用設施下尚未償還的 5 億美元本金，以及相關費用。剩餘資金用於一般企業用途。

於 2025 年 10 月 10 日，Lennar 行使其根據註冊權協議所享有的註冊權，並啟動將其截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日所持有的 Millrose 約 20% 總發行普通股兌換為 Lennar 級 A 普通股的兌換要約（"兌換要約"）。於 2025 年 11 月 26 日，Lennar 公告兌換要約結果，Lennar 接受總計 8,049,594 張 Lennar 級 A 普通股，以兌換 Millrose 級 A 普通股 33,298,754 張。兌換要約於 2025 年 11 月 28 日完成。完成兌換要約後，Lennar 現在持有極小數量的普通股。

paragraphs: 您應配合本表單 10-K 所附之合併財務報表及相關附註，閱讀下列管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析。部分內容屬於前瞻性陳述，涉及風險與不確定性。實際結果可能與這些前瞻性陳述中所討論的結果有重大差異。導致這些差異的因素包括，但不僅限於，以下及本表單 10-K 其他部分所討論的內容，特別是標題為「前瞻性陳述之警示聲明」的段落。這些前瞻性陳述所提及的內容，受風險、不確定性及其他因素影響，可能導致實際結果與這些陳述中所提及、預測或暗示的結果有重大差異。請參閱標題為「第一部分，項目 1A. 風險因素」及「前瞻性陳述之警示聲明」的段落，以瞭解與這些陳述相關的風險、不確定性及假設。

如進一步說明於本表單 10-K「第二部分，項目 8. 財務報表與補充資料」所附之合併財務報表的附註 1. 事業說明中所述，我們於 2025 年 2 月 7 日完成了從 Lennar 的分拆。本處所呈現的財務資訊（i）於 2025 年 2 月 7 日分拆前的期間，為前一階段 Millrose 事業的財務資訊，來自 Lennar 的合併財務報表及會計記錄；（ii）於 2025 年 2 月 7 日分拆後的期間，為 Millrose 及其子公司之財務資訊。Millrose 於 2024 年 3 月 19 日成立，並自 2025 年 2 月 7 日分拆後，作為獨立公司運作。

Millrose 為於馬裏蘭州法律下設立的公司，設立日期為 2024 年 3 月 19 日。Millrose 於 2025 年 2 月 7 日完成從 Lennar 的分拆，成為獨立公開上市的公司，其 A 級普通股於紐約證券交易所（NYSE）上市，代碼為「MRP」。我們透過選擇權契約，購買並開發住宅用地，並向住宅建商出售完工住宅用地，契約中預定成本與提撥計畫。我們為住宅建商提供解決方案，使其能擴大對完工住宅用地的取得，同時實施輕資產策略。當 Millrose 銷售完工住宅用地時，資金會重新投入未來的住宅用地取得，為對應方提供長期的社區成長取得管道。我們的選擇權契約允許對應方在契約期間支付定期選擇權費用。在較小程度上，我們也為部分第三方對應方提供以單戶住宅用地為擔保的開發貸款。我們由 KL 進行外部管理與諮詢，根據管理契約。
於分發日，我們透過向 2025 年 1 月 21 日營業日結束時持有 Lennar 普通股的股東發放約 80% 的 Millrose 普通股，完成了從 Lennar 的分拆。在分拆過程中，我們從 Lennar 獲得約 55 億美元的土地資產，代表約 87,000 個住宅用地，以及約 10 億美元現金，其中包括 5.85 億美元的選擇權契約現金存款負債。
我們於 2025 年 2 月 10 日完成了對 RCH Holdings, Inc. 全部已發行股票的收購，該公司為 Rausch 的新成立母公司，收購約 25,000 個住宅用地，以約 8.59 億美元現金進行，扣除 Lennar 資金支持的選擇權押金及其他保留款。

Lennar 於 2025 年 10 月 10 日根據註冊權契約行使註冊權，並啟動交換要約。Lennar 於 2025 年 11 月 26 日宣佈交換要約結果，接受總計 8,049,594 張 Lennar A 級普通股，以交換 33,298,754 張 Millrose A 級普通股。交換要約於 2025 年 11 月 28 日完成。因此，Lennar 在交換要約完成後，僅持有極小數量的普通股。

於 2025 年 5 月 12 日，本公司與 New Home 籤訂協議，為 Millrose 提供最高 7 億美元的土地銀行資金，以支持 New Home 收購 Landsea。New Home 於 2025 年 6 月 25 日完成收購 Landsea，本公司於收購閉幕時提供 4.945 億美元的土地銀行資金，用於收購一組住宅用地，本公司與 New Home 簽訂選擇權契約。因此，本公司取得價值 5.228 億美元的土地資產，包含 4,186 個住宅用地，以 4.945 億美元現金取得，扣除 2,830 萬美元的選擇權契約押金。

在 New Home 交易中，本公司於 2025 年 6 月 24 日簽訂 DDTL 借款協議，提供延遲提款的長期貸款設施，總承諾金額為 10 億美元，原定於 2026 年 6 月 23 日到期。DDTL 借款協議的資金用於 New Home 收購 Landsea，以及任何剩餘資金可用於一般公司用途。於 2025 年 9 月 11 日，DDTL 借款協議終止，所有債務已全部償還（進一步說明如下）。
於2025年8月7日，本公司完成發行總金額為12.5億美元的2030年票據（"2025年8月發行"）。2025年8月發行的淨資金用以償還DDTL信貸融資下5億美元本金及循環信貸融資下4.5億美元本金，餘額則用於一般營運用途。
於2025年9月11日，本公司完成發行總金額為7.5億美元的2032年票據（"2025年9月發行"）。2025年9月發行的淨資金用以償還DDTL信貸融資下剩餘5億美元本金及相關費用，餘額則用於一般營運用途。

投資資本為非GAAP財務指標，代表對手方支付月度選擇權費用的金額。投資資本包含本公司合併財務報表中與（i）選擇權契約下的住宅用地、（ii）開發貸款應收款及（iii）負債相關的部分。與之最接近的GAAP財務指標為財務報表中所列的選擇權契約下的住宅用地。管理階層使用投資資本作為衡量已投入資本的指標，並認為該指標對投資者而言具有參考價值，因其為產生選擇權費用及其他相關收入的基礎。此非GAAP指標僅供投資者瞭解本公司管理階層如何評估基礎營運表現，並非，也不應視為GAAP指標的替代，應與本公司GAAP財務指標一併參考。

headings: 與我們商業模式及對新成立實體之投資相關之風險
本公司為一新成立之公司，營運歷史有限，您對本公司達成商業目標或作為獨立且分離之業務之能力評估基礎有限。
Rausch 交易包含位於 Lennar 歷史運作地理區域以外之資產，且該地理區域之房地產價值可能與 Lennar 歷史運作之地理區域不同。
本公司面臨因資產組合高度集中而產生之風險。
本公司之再生資本商業模式依賴於我們之交易對手選擇行使其土地購買新選項。
本公司與 Lennar 之間之協議涉及利益衝突，我們可能從非關係第三方獲得較佳之條款，而這些協議中所獲得之條款則較差。
Lennar 依創始人權利協議行使其執行權，可能嚴重不利於本公司之業務運作與財務狀況。
本公司尚未取得獨立評估或公平意見，以評估本公司之不動產資產價值，包括自 Lennar 之分拆交易中取得之資產及 Rausch 交易中取得之資產。
我們尚未取得所有不動產資產的環境報告，且我們依賴對手方提供有關住宅用地的某些資訊。
不動產資產的所有權可能面臨環境風險與責任，這些風險與責任可能未被對手方契約中提供的陳述與保證及賠償條款所涵蓋。
我們需遵守廣泛的總體經濟與產業特定法律及法規，以保護環境，這些法規要求的合規作業可能繁重且成本高昂。
對手方對我們不動產資產進行土地開發的義務，可能對我們的業務產生負面影響。
若我們或我們的主要對手方，包括Lennar，進入破產程序，則對手方契約可能無法執行。
若我們無法繼續簽訂新的對手方契約，且可能受到資本優先權的限制，則我們的業務與收入來源可能受到重大且不利的影響。
我們不動產投資組合的市場價值下降，可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大且不利的影響。
Kennedy Lewis及其相關公司的管理團隊過去的表現，可能無法反映我們未來的表現。
若我們無法籌措額外資金以支應營運資金，或無法以具吸引力的條件取得資金，我們可能無法持續維持營運資金。
市場波動可能影響我們從事業務的能力。
作為一家控股公司，我們對子公司的現金流量依賴，可能對我們的業務產生負面影響。
若我們被要求根據投資公司法登記為投資公司，您的投資回報可能受到不利影響。
我們的科技平台若發生中斷，可能影響我們執行交易及循環資金的能力。
與我們債務義務相關的風險
我們可能無法產生足夠現金以償還所有債務。
儘管我們目前的債務水準，我們仍可能進一步增加大量債務，包括擔保債務，及其他義務。
本公司之債務協議包含限制條款，限制本公司在經營業務時之靈活性。
本公司之負債使其面臨利率風險。
與土地銀行業相關之風險
擁有土地用以興建新住宅 inherently 存在重大風險。
本公司之業務易受天然災害、地緣政治事件及其他超出本公司控制範圍之因素影響，可能延宕本公司持有之土地資產之開發。
本公司之保險 coverage 可能不足以涵蓋所有潛在之損失。
paragraphs: 本公司業務涉及重大風險。任何上述風險因素或本Form 10-K其他部分所描述的風險因素，都可能顯著且不利地影響本公司業務前景、財務狀況及營運成果。下列所描述的風險並非本公司唯一面臨的風險。其他未為本公司所知或目前認為不重要之風險與不確定性，亦可能不利地影響本公司。

Millrose於2024年3月19日在馬裏蘭州成立為一家公司，其A級普通股於2025年2月7日於紐約證券交易所上市，當時為從Lennar分拆而出。由於本公司作為獨立上市公司之營運歷史有限，您對本公司達成業務目標及作為獨立且分離之業務表現之能力評估基礎有限。本Form 10-K中所包含之分拆前期間財務資訊，並未反映本公司作為獨立上市公司在分拆前期間可能實現之財務狀況、營運成果或現金流，亦未反映本公司未來可能實現之財務狀況、營運成果或現金流。分拆前之Millrose業務財務資訊亦未反映作為上市公司所需額外成本，以及維持符合所有適用法律法規之費用。
若本公司未能達成業務目標，將產生有限之營運收入，可能無法作為獨立業務進行運作與成長。可能對本公司結果產生重大且不利影響的因素，包括但不限於以下事項：
• 分拆未包含任何現有營運、人力或其它基礎設施之過渡。本公司未受益於Lennar所提供之行政與支援服務，而是依管理協議之條款，依賴管理人。因此，本公司之業務、營運、場地、人力、基礎設施、系統及其他資源皆為新近建立，且完全獨立於Lennar，並與Lenn、ar之資源不具可比性，除非根據主計畫協議所提供之服務。
• 自分拆後，本公司之主要業務與收入來源為根據Lennar協議由Lennar提供。雖然Millrose已取得其他住宅建造商作為新對手方，但無法保證Millrose將持續成功與其他對手方協商協議。Millrose預期未來之安排將與目前與對手方之安排相似，但無法確定Millrose將能成功協商取得與目前對手方協議中 substantially 相同之條款，包括與 pooling 有關之條款。
• 自分拆後，本公司之主要業務與收入來源為根據Lennar協議由Lennar提供。雖然Millrose已取得其他住宅建造商作為新對手方，但無法保證Millrose將持續成功與其他對手方協商協議。Millrose預期未來之安排將與目前與對手方之安排相似，但無法確定Millrose將能成功協商取得與目前對手方協議中 substantially 相同之條款，包括與 pooling 有關之條款。
